# Lumen 2.1.0

This release brings full internationalization to the desktop client, a pre-backup review dialog, smoother file preparation, and a healthy batch of interface polish and bug fixes.

### Interface, Motion & Typography
- **Pre-Backup Upload Review Dialog**: Selecting files or folders used to blindly enqueue everything into the upload pipeline right away. Now you get an Expressive Material 3 review sheet showing the exact photo and video counts, total payload size, and target album mapping before any network requests start. When the selection contains a folder, an "Include subfolders" toggle appears right in the dialog — shown only for folder selections, never for plain photos or videos — and your choice is passed straight through to the upload so what you review is exactly what gets uploaded.
- **Switched to Google Sans Flex**: Lumen Desktop now runs on Google Sans Flex across the entire interface. Headers and titles get the clean rounded look, variable weights scale naturally across display densities, and the typography stays visually consistent whether your OS came with the font or not.
- **Material 3 Expressive Language Dialog**: Added an in-app language picker in Settings with instant live switching. Changing languages updates the UI immediately without needing to relaunch the app, and persists your choice to config across restarts.

### Bug Fixes & Improvements
- **Desktop Auth & Stage 2 Token Resolution (#19)**: Adding credentials via Embedded Setup or auth strings used to report success during Stage 1 (`oauth_token` -> `master_token`) but then fail during uploads with a generic "auth response missing Auth token" error when exchanging for the `photos.native` bearer token. Credential setup now verifies Stage 2 token acquisition against Google's auth service before saving, aligns the mobile auth endpoint with Android, and surfaces the exact error response from Google instead of masking it.
- **No More Stuck "0 out of 0" Indexing Screen**: Dropping or selecting large files (like heavy video files) used to jump straight into the upload view with an empty `0 of 0` counter and idle threads while the backend silently traversed files and hashed SHA-1 checksums on disk. Now the UI holds on a dedicated preparation screen, showing live scanned counts and directory progress until the first worker actually starts uploading.
- **Live Thread Status & Error Translations**: Worker thread progress (e.g. "Uploading...", "Hashing...", "Waiting for files...") and cancelled backup error banners used to be hardcoded English strings. They now translate smoothly in real time across all supported locales.
- **Localized Desktop Notifications**: Native OS desktop notifications for backup start, completion, pause, resume, and errors now match your chosen language rather than firing in hardcoded English.
- **Subfolder Recursion Toggle in Review**: Toggling the subfolder switch inside the pre-backup review modal now triggers a live rescan of the selected directories and updates the item counter and total size on the fly. The toggle is per-upload only — it no longer lives in Settings or on the Backup drop card, so dropping a folder never silently changes your global preferences.
- **Bottom Drop Strip & Mid-Upload Queueing**: The "Drop more photos, videos, or folders here" strip moved from the top of the upload view to the bottom, below the progress card and the file queue, so adding another batch is one natural eye movement after scanning the list. Dropping files while a batch is uploading now queues them cleanly: the upload view stays put (no more preparation screen flashing over your running batch) and a toast confirms "Added to queue — it will start after the current backup finishes."
- **Live Scan Counts for File Selections**: The preparation screen's "N files found" counter only updated during folder traversals. Dropping or picking a flat list of files (videos, photos) now emits throttled scan progress too, so the indexing screen shows real numbers immediately instead of sitting at zero until the first upload starts.
- **Language Preference Sync**: Synchronized language preferences between the desktop UI and the core engine configuration so your choice survives app restarts and CLI syncs.

### Internationalization & Translations
- **Four Supported Languages**: Lumen now speaks English (`en`), Indonesian (`id` / Bahasa Indonesia), Japanese (`ja` / 日本語), and Spanish (`es` / Español).
- **Full UI Translation Coverage**: All primary navigation tabs, settings panels, account picker menus, dialogs, folder mapping views, and preflight warnings are fully localized.
- **New Strings Localized**: The preparation screen ("Preparing your files"), the review dialog's subfolder toggle, and the queue-confirmation toast are translated across all four supported languages from day one.

### Core Engine & CI
- **Multi-Platform Dev Builds**: GitHub Actions CI now automatically compiles and publishes debug dev builds with developer tools enabled across Linux, macOS, and Windows on the `rust-dev` branch.
- **Safe Glob Matching in CI**: Replaced fragile wildcard paths in Linux and macOS staging steps with safe shell globbing so packaging steps don't fail unexpectedly.
- **Trademark & Nominative Fair Use Updates**: Added legal disclaimers and updated project descriptions regarding Google Photos nominative fair use.
